svg.desc: Based in Israel. Owner of openowl.cc and valkbypass.com. Working on new projects and developing current ones. Discord: lishaygfx and neverwentlegit. Rotating ASCII torus knot from ASCII Magic. LishayGFX builds websites, apps and FiveM work, mostly through vibe coding. Stack: Next.js, React, JavaScript, HTML, FiveM, Lua and C++. On GitHub since 2021. 2 public repositories, 0 public repository stars, 0 followers. Atlas Survival: Official Atlas Survival Minecraft resource pack releases. Latest stable release v1.0.8. Animated contribution calendar. Updated 2026-11-04 UTC.
